Airtel Corporate Gifting vs Airtel SME Data Plans

On some VTU portals, you may see listings for both Airtel SME and Airtel Corporate Gifting (CG) plans. Airtel SME data relies on small-scale business sharing limits and can occasionally face latency issues during network upgrades. Airtel Corporate Gifting, however, relies on enterprise-grade APIs designed for high-volume delivery. While CG plans are sometimes N5 to N10 more expensive per gigabyte, their delivery speed is much more stable, making them the preferred choice for resellers who value client trust and want to avoid transaction errors, ensuring business continuity.
